topic: RA treat-to-target strategy: DAS28, SDAI, CDAI remission thresholds

source.title: Treating rheumatoid arthritis to target: 2014 update of the recommendations of an international task force
source.whyItFits: Open task-force update on treat-to-target in rheumatoid arthritis, including which composite scores to use and the evidence that a target beats usual care.

whyItFits: Open task-force update on treat-to-target in rheumatoid arthritis, including which composite scores to use and the evidence that a target beats usual care.
coverageNote: DAS28 <2.6 is the numeric threshold explicitly used. SDAI and CDAI are named; their numeric cut-offs are not invented.
rejectedInAppHints: A giant-cell arteritis treat-to-target paper was the in-app neighbor and was not used for RA thresholds.
